existing_features.title: Remove the profile setup flow so authenticated users are never prompted to complete a "Set up your profile" dialog, and the app remains usable even when the caller has no saved profile.

Update/change the user interface with a cohesive, consistent visual refresh across the login screen, header, tab navigation, page surfaces, and dialogs (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling). Use English for all user-facing text.
